    • testAddingABundlePreviouslyAssociatedWithAResourceContext

      public void testAddingABundlePreviouslyAssociatedWithAResourceContext() throws IllegalArgumentException, ResourceContextException
      Test case 2 : adding a bundle previously associated with a ResourceContext. This test case tests the adding of a bundle previously added to another ResourceContext.
      Throws:

    • testRemoveBundleFromAResourceContext

      public void testRemoveBundleFromAResourceContext() throws IllegalArgumentException, ResourceContextException
      Test case 3 : removing a bundle from a ResourceContext. This test case validates the removing of a bundle from a ResourceContext (and checks that a ResourceContextEvent is received).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - , see ResourceMonitoringService.createContext(String, ResourceContext)
      ResourceContextException - , see ResourceContext.addBundle(long) ResourceContext.removeBundle(long)

    • testRemoveABundleWithADestinationResourceContext

      public void testRemoveABundleWithADestinationResourceContext() throws IllegalArgumentException, ResourceContextException
      Test case 4 : removing a bundle with a destination ResourceContext. This test case tests the removing of a bundle from a context with a destination context (expects one ResourceContextEvent from removing the bundle and one more for adding it into another ResourceContext).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - , see ResourceMonitoringService.createContext(String, ResourceContext)
      ResourceContextException - , see ResourceContext.addBundle(long) ResourceContext.removeBundle(long)

    • testRemoveABundleWithANullDestinationResourceContext

      public void testRemoveABundleWithANullDestinationResourceContext() throws IllegalArgumentException, ResourceContextException
      Test case 5 : removing a bundle with a null destination ResourceContext. This test case validates the removing of a bundle from a ResourceContext with a null destination. This test case is similar to testRemoveBundleFromAResourceContext() (Expect a REMOVED_BUNDLE event).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - , see ResourceMonitoringService.createContext(String, ResourceContext)
      ResourceContextException - , see ResourceContext.addBundle(long) ResourceContext.removeBundle(long)

    • testRemovingABundleWithADestinationContextWhichHasBeenPreviouslyDeleted

      public void testRemovingABundleWithADestinationContextWhichHasBeenPreviouslyDeleted() throws IllegalArgumentException, ResourceContextException
      Test case 6 : removing a bundle with a destination context which has been previously deleted. This test case checks the removing of a bundle from a ResourceContext with a destination Resource Context which has been removed (Expect a ResourceContextException when invoking ResourceContext.removeBundle(long, ResourceContext)).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - , see ResourceMonitoringService.createContext(String, ResourceContext)
      ResourceContextException - , see ResourceContext.addBundle(long) ResourceContext.removeBundle(long)
